trips.route_note: Fast ferries and buses run directly from Montevideo to Colonia in roughly 2.5–3 hours; the ferry terminal and historic quarter are a short walk apart.

trips.why: Buses run direct from Tres Cruces in about 2h 50m and drop you a short walk from the historic quarter, so no car or taxi is needed.
know: Book bus tickets ahead, especially on weekends and holidays
The historic quarter is a UNESCO site best explored on foot
Spring and autumn offer the most comfortable walking weather
